about: Q2-1 wording classification compatibility vectors. Each vector is one research set with one source and one candidate. Field q1 is the expected result of lib/buyer-questions classifyApprovedWording (checked offline by scripts/test-q2p-schema-contract.ts); field db is the expected first classification written by approve_buyer_question_set (checked by the Level 2 harness). Format: classification/rule/verification, empty for null; refused when Q1 refuses the research set. Rule: the database never records observed unless Q1 does, with the same verification. Expected values are written by hand. No string may contain a single quote, because the file is passed to SQL as a literal.
